title: REPORT on Banking Union – annual report 2024
part_text: Text as a whole without the words: ‘fully integrated’
part_context: Regrets that EU banks’ cross-border activity is still rather limited, particularly with regard to granting loans; takes the view, therefore, that it is important to complete the BU in order to uphold the free movement of capital in a <del>fully integrated</del> internal market;
